name: Quote
description: One saying, given a short scene that makes it land. Pick it for a proverb, a line from a speech or a piece of advice.

structure.purpose: A moment that makes the viewer need the saying: who is speaking, or the trouble it answers.
The saying itself, word for word, with time to read it.
One line on what it means for the viewer today.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds show a picture that raises a question. No greeting and no logo intro.

rules: The wording of the quote and who said it are checked against a saved source.
When nobody knows who first said it, the video says so and names no one.
